readout.summary: Analysts lean Denver straight up but split on the spread. The Broncos (8-2, six straight wins, 8-2 ATS) beat the Raiders 38-24 on Sunday, while the Steelers (6-4, 4-0 at home) turn to Mason Rudolph after Aaron Rodgers was benched. Sports Betting Dime backs Denver -4.5, citing its red-zone TD rate (67.7% vs 42.9%), and ATS.io says Denver's pass rush (31 sacks, 4th in blitz rate) will trouble Pittsburgh. The contrarian case comes from SI Betting and CBS Sports: Pittsburgh is far better at home and leads the league in rush EPA against a Denver run defense that ranks 26th; CBS picks the Steelers 23-20. ESPN's matchup predictor also leans Pittsburgh (51.9%) despite a -229 market. Rain and wind are expected, and Steelers pass rushers Herbig and Highsmith carry injury tags.

CBS, Covers, Dimers, SI's Dewey and numberFire (76.8%) favor the Rams at home, pointing to a run game averaging 163.5 yards over four weeks and a defense allowing about 13 points a game during a four-game win streak. TheLines, WagerTalk and Pickswise back Green Bay, arguing the Rams beat weak teams and are thin on offense without Puka Nacua and Davante Adams (both on IR), plus OL Steve Avila and Coleman Shelton (out). Micah Parsons was activated and is expected to debut on a snap count; Josh Jacobs is questionable (finger). The Under is the most common bet (SI, TheLines, WagerTalk, Pickswise, Covers).

readout.summary: No track: Dallas key starter out (TE Jake Ferguson, knee/ankle, ruled Out); it would be on the Watch list otherwise (score 25). Analysts back Dallas heavily: 20 of 26 published picks take the Cowboys (-8.5; moneyline -481 to -500, about 83%; ESPN FPI 82.9%), including all three ESPN analysts (30-20, 30-17, 31-20) and CBS (41-27). The case is the offense mismatch: Philadelphia is last in yards (255.6) and 31st in scoring (16.7) with Joe Milton starting while Hurts is on IR, and Prescott has 11 TDs and 1 INT over his last three games. Dallas is without Ferguson, G Tyler Booker, S P.J. Locke and WR Jonathan Mingo; Philadelphia is without CB Jonathan Jones and OLB Arnold Ebiketie, but CB Quinyon Mitchell has no designation. Dissent: Covers and FantasyLife take Eagles +8.5 (pass rush has 11 sacks in two games, Dallas run defense last), and four local columnists pick an outright Eagles upset.
